-- What a client importing `Proof.go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.CmpRecs` sees of it (generated by etc/gen-interface.py; do not edit).
-- Every declaration also takes the ambient section variables (left out below): the Go semantics
-- (`ext`, `ffi`, `go_gctx`, `sem`, the package's `Assumptions`), `GF`, `hG`, `StorageModel GF`, `AllG GF`.

theorem mvcc.CmpRecs.finRev_empty : mvcc.CmpRecs.empty.finRev = -1

theorem mvcc.recsPos_crev (r : mvcc.CmpRecs) (h : mvcc.recsPos r) : r.crev = -1 ∨ 1 ≤ r.crev

def mvcc.CmpRecs.at (r : mvcc.CmpRecs) (kn : GoString) : Option w64 :=
  if kn = mvcc.finKeyBytes then r.fin else r.sched

theorem mvcc.metaReadSpecR_empty (rt : GoInterfaceOk) (Rd : GoSlice → GoString → IProp GF) (Tok :
    IProp GF) : mvcc.metaReadSpecR rt (some mvcc.CmpRecs.empty) Rd Tok = mvcc.metaReadSpec rt true
    Rd Tok

theorem mvcc.recsOk_crev_lt (L : mvcc.Log) (r : mvcc.CmpRecs) (h : mvcc.recsOk L r) (hL : 2 ≤
    List.length L) : r.crev < ↑(List.length L)

theorem mvcc.CmpRecs.resumes_empty : mvcc.CmpRecs.empty.resumes = false

theorem mvcc.metaReadSpecR_persistent (rt : GoInterfaceOk) (rs : Option mvcc.CmpRecs) (Rd : GoSlice
    → GoString → IProp GF) (Tok : IProp GF) : Persistent (mvcc.metaReadSpecR rt rs Rd Tok)

theorem mvcc.CmpRecs.crev_empty : mvcc.CmpRecs.empty.crev = -1

theorem mvcc.CmpRecs.at_sched (r : mvcc.CmpRecs) : r.at mvcc.schedKeyBytes = r.sched

theorem mvcc.CmpRecs.at_fin (r : mvcc.CmpRecs) : r.at mvcc.finKeyBytes = r.fin

theorem mvcc.recsSign_at (r : mvcc.CmpRecs) (h : mvcc.recsSign r) (kn : GoString) (x : w64) (hx :
    r.at kn = some x) : 0 ≤ sint.Z x

theorem mvcc.recsOk_sign (L : mvcc.Log) (r : mvcc.CmpRecs) (h : mvcc.recsOk L r) : mvcc.recsSign r

def mvcc.metaReadSpecR (rt : GoInterfaceOk) (rs : Option mvcc.CmpRecs) (Rd : GoSlice → GoString →
    IProp GF) (Tok : IProp GF) : IProp GF :=
  match rs with
  | none => mvcc.metaReadSpec rt false Rd Tok
  | some r =>
    if r = mvcc.CmpRecs.empty then mvcc.metaReadSpec rt true Rd Tok
    else
      iprop(∀ b key kn dq,
          ⌜mvcc.metaCompactKey kn⌝ →
            □
              ∀ Φ,
                typedPointsto (globalAddr go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.schema.Meta) b DFrac.discard ∗
                    Tok ∗ ownSlice key kn dq -∗
                  (▷
                      ∀ ks vs,
                        Tok ∗
                            ownSlice key kn dq ∗
                              (⌜r.at kn = none⌝ ∗ ownSlice ks [] DFrac.discard ∗ ownSlice vs [] DFrac.discard ∨
                                ∃ ksl vsl x,
                                  ⌜r.at kn = some x ∧ 0 ≤ sint.Z x⌝ ∗
                                    ownSlice ks [ksl] DFrac.discard ∗
                                      Rd ksl kn ∗
                                        ownSlice vs [vsl] DFrac.discard ∗
                                          Rd vsl (mvcc.revBytes { main := x, sub := W64 0 } false)) -∗
                          Φ (intoVal ks, intoVal vs)) -∗
                    WP
                      (((((intoVal
                                (methods rt.ty go!"UnsafeRange"
                                  rt.v))
                              (intoVal b))
                            (intoVal key))
                          (intoVal slice.nil))
                        (intoVal (W64 0)))
                      {{ Φ }})

def mvcc.recsSign (r : mvcc.CmpRecs) : Prop :=
  (∀ (x : w64), r.fin = some x → 0 ≤ sint.Z x) ∧ ∀ (x : w64), r.sched = some x → 0 ≤ sint.Z x

theorem mvcc.metaReadSpecR_none (rt : GoInterfaceOk) (Rd : GoSlice → GoString → IProp GF) (Tok :
    IProp GF) : mvcc.metaReadSpecR rt none Rd Tok = mvcc.metaReadSpec rt false Rd Tok
